# Everyday Digital Explained

> Plain-English steps for protecting your parents and running a small business. Every fact checked against the official source.

## Small-business money admin

- [BOI Report Letter Demanding a Fee? U.S. Companies Don't File Now](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/boi-report-letter-scam-us-companies-exempt/): FinCEN says U.S. companies no longer file BOI reports. It has no Form 4022 or 5102 and charges no fee to file. Don't scan the QR code; check fincen.gov/boi.
- [How do I find a free business mentor (SCORE or SBDC) by ZIP code?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/free-small-business-mentor-score-sbdc/): Use the SBA's local assistance tool to find SCORE mentors and your Small Business Development Center by ZIP code. What each offers and what it costs.
- [Is the 1099-K threshold for payment apps $20,000 and 200 sales?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/1099-k-20000-200-transactions-rule/): Payment apps must send a 1099-K only over $20,000 and 200 transactions. Card payments have no minimum, and you report income even without a form.
- [What does payroll software do when you hire your first employee?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/first-employee-payroll-what-software-does/): Employee or contractor, the IRS steps (EIN, W-4, I-9, FICA, FUTA, deposits, W-2s due Feb. 1, 2027) and what payroll software can't do for you.
- [How do I turn a shoebox of receipts into a clean spreadsheet?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/receipts-to-spreadsheet-small-business/): What the IRS says to keep and for how long, how to sort receipts, using AI or a phone scan, and the bank-statement check you can't skip.
- [How do I turn a voice memo into a professional invoice?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/voice-memo-to-invoice/): What a clear invoice includes, a sample AI prompt that turns job notes into line items, how to check quantities and rates, payment terms and records.
- [Is the 1099-NEC threshold now $2,000 instead of $600?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/1099-nec-2000-threshold/): For payments made after Dec. 31, 2025, the 1099-NEC threshold is $2,000, not $600. 2026 forms are due Feb. 1, 2027. Plus W-9s and card/app 1099-K rules.
- [Which 2026 IRS mileage rate do I use: 72.5 or 76 cents?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/2026-irs-mileage-rate-two-rates/): The IRS raised the 2026 business mileage rate to 76 cents a mile for driving on or after July 1, 2026. Before that it was 72.5 cents. How to split a log.
- [Is an EIN free, and how do I get one from the IRS?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/free-ein-from-irs/): Yes, an EIN is free from the IRS. See who needs one, what to have ready, the online hours, and the 1-per-day limit. Sites that charge are not the IRS.

## Protect your parents

- [How Do I Close a Loved One's Facebook, Google, or Apple Account?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/close-accounts-after-death-facebook-google-apple/): After a death, Facebook, Google, and Apple each have their own request page and ask for different proof. Here's where to go and what each one needs.
- [How Do I Freeze My Child's Credit for Free? (Under 16)](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/freeze-child-credit-free-under-16/): The FTC says parents can get a free credit freeze for a child under 16. What Equifax, Experian and TransUnion each ask for, and where to mail it.
- [What Is a Small Succession in Louisiana? The New $200,000 Limit](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/louisiana-small-succession-limit/): Louisiana calls probate 'succession.' Since Aug. 1, 2026, a small succession for a Louisiana resident is $200,000 or less in gross value. What that means.
- [Work-From-Home Job Sent You a Check? Is It a Scam, and What Do I Do?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/work-from-home-job-fake-check-scam/): The FTC says no honest employer sends a check and asks you to send part back. Don't send money, don't pay for a job, and report it at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.
- [How Do I Set Up a Legacy Contact for My Apple Account?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/apple-legacy-contact-how-to-set-up/): Add an Apple Legacy Contact in a few taps, share the access key, and learn what your family can and can't get to after you die, per Apple Support.
- [Told to Pay With a Gift Card? Is It a Scam, and What If I Already Did?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/gift-card-payment-scam-what-to-do/): The FTC says only scammers ask you to pay with a gift card. If you already did, call the card company, keep the card and receipt, and report it to the FTC.
- [How Do I Set Up Google's Inactive Account Manager?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/google-inactive-account-manager-set-up/): Google may delete a personal account unused for 2 years. Inactive Account Manager lets you pick up to 10 people to get your data, or have the account deleted.
- [How Do You Read Your Medicare Annual Notice of Change?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/medicare-annual-notice-of-change-how-to-read/): Your plan's Annual Notice of Change lists what changes on Jan. 1, 2027. What to check in it, and what to do before Open Enrollment ends Dec. 7, 2026.
- [Got an "Unpaid Toll" Text? Is It a Scam, and What Should I Do?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/unpaid-toll-text-scam-what-to-do/): The FTC says unpaid toll texts are probably a scam. Don't tap the link. Check with your toll agency yourself, forward the text to 7726, and report it.
- [How Do I Protect My Family From AI Voice-Clone Scam Calls?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/ai-voice-clone-scam-family-safe-word/): Scammers can clone a loved one's voice. Set a family safe word, hang up and call back, turn on iPhone or Pixel call screening, and report the call.
- [How Do I Freeze My Credit at All Three Bureaus for Free?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/freeze-credit-all-three-bureaus-free/): A credit freeze is free by federal law. Official freeze pages and phone numbers for Equifax, Experian and TransUnion, and how fast a freeze must be lifted.
- [How Do You Use the Official Medicare Plan Finder for 2027 Plans?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/how-to-use-medicare-plan-finder/): A neutral walkthrough of Medicare Plan Finder: logging in or not, adding drugs and pharmacies, cost estimates, star ratings, filters and free help.
- [Medical Alert Button vs Smartwatch: What Does Each One Do?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/medical-alert-button-vs-smartwatch/): How medical alert systems and Apple Watch or Pixel Watch fall detection work, what to ask about fees and canceling, and whether Medicare pays for them.
- [I Got Scammed. What Should I Do in the First Hour?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/scammed-what-to-do-first-hour/): Paid a scammer? Contact the company you paid right away, by payment type. Then report it at ReportFraud.ftc.gov and IC3, and skip "recovery" offers.
- [How Do I Check if My Password Has Been Leaked? (Free Tools)](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/check-if-password-leaked-free/): Check your email and passwords for leaks free with Have I Been Pwned, Google Password Checkup, or iPhone Passwords, then fix leaks and turn on passkeys.
- [How Do Scammers Get My Address? Data Brokers and How to Opt Out](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/data-broker-removal-how-scammers-get-your-address/): People-search sites sell your address to anyone who pays. Here are 3 ways out: California's free DROP platform, free manual opt-outs, or a paid service.
- [What Can You Change During Medicare Open Enrollment (Oct 15–Dec 7)?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/medicare-open-enrollment-what-you-can-change/): Medicare Open Enrollment runs Oct 15–Dec 7, 2026. What you can change for 2027, what you can't, the Medigap catch, and where to get free help.
- [Did Medicare Really Call You? How to Spot 3 Medicare Scams](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/medicare-scam-red-flags-open-enrollment/): Medicare won't call out of the blue for your Medicare Number. How to spot the fake new-card call, free braces, and free genetic tests, and where to report.
- [Is a "Your Package Is Delayed" Text a Scam? How to Check the Link](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/package-delivery-text-scam-check-link/): What USPS, UPS and FedEx say about delivery texts, how to check a link without tapping it, how to report it to 7726, and what to do if you already tapped.
- [How Do I Stop Pre-Approved Credit Card Offers and Junk Calls?](https://jirv71.github.io/everydaydigitalexplained/stop-prescreened-credit-offers-do-not-call/): Opt out of prescreened credit offers at OptOutPrescreen.com or 1-888-5-OPT-OUT, then add your phones to DoNotCall.gov. What each one does and doesn't stop.
